Action English: The boita is moored, its sail furled. Hema folds cloth on a mat. Raghu lifts a large cargo bundle. Hari arranges a rope on the landing. Malati comes over to Hema.
Sound English: Soft water, cloth rustling and indistinct work sounds farther away.
Performance English: Let the preparation register before the first line.

Camera English: Medium two-shot of mother and daughter.
Action English: Malati holds out her empty hands. Hema gives her a small open wrapping cloth containing three cloth samples.
Performance English: Hema genuinely entrusts her with the task.

Camera English: Over Malati’s shoulder, close on hands and samples.
Action English: Malati studies the three samples: dark, light and one with a narrow border. Hema points out the samples.
Performance English: Malati looks again, more carefully this time.

Camera English: Close on her hands, then her face.
Action English: Malati brings the two ends together and ties the wrapping. Hema starts to help, then lets her finish it herself.

Camera English: Malati in the foreground; Raghu and the boat beyond.
Action English: Hari is ready to board. Raghu finishes his task and holds a hand out to Malati. Her pleased smile fades.
Sound English: Water, footsteps and a soft rope scrape.
Performance English: Her fingers tighten around the knot.

Camera English: Medium side angle: the audience can see the parcel behind her, Raghu cannot.
Action English: Malati moves both hands behind her waist, hiding the small parcel with her body. Raghu stands in front of her.
Sound English: A small breath before she speaks.

Camera English: Over Raghu’s shoulder onto Malati’s face.
Action English: Malati quickly finds a question. Raghu glances towards the boat’s shelter. Her hands remain behind her.
Sound English: The voices stay close; work sounds recede.
Performance English: The last question comes a little too quickly.

Camera English: Side two-shot; Hema turns in the background.
Action English: Raghu answers, then notices his still-empty hand. Malati looks down. Hema turns from her work.
Performance English: The audience knows where it is; the adults still do not.

Camera English: Wider three-shot with Malati at one side.
Action English: Hema lifts the folded cloth to look underneath. Raghu checks an empty basket nearby. Malati starts to speak, then stops.
Sound English: The sound of unfolding cloth comes forward.
Performance English: Malati does not invent an answer; her silence prolongs the search.

Camera English: Close side view of Malati and her concealed hands, with Hema’s reopened cloth beyond.
Action English: Watching Hema undo the finished work, Malati loosens her grip on the knot. She looks at her mother’s hands, then towards her father.
Sound English: No dialogue. Cloth and quiet water.
Performance English: Let the decision become visible in her face and hands.

Action English: Before anyone points it out, Malati brings the parcel forward herself. Hema’s hands stop. Raghu turns towards her.
Performance English: She keeps looking at the knot; there is more to say.

Camera English: From Raghu’s side, close on Malati’s face and the parcel.
Action English: Malati looks up. Her eyes are a little wet, but she does not collapse into sobbing. Raghu lets her finish.
Sound English: Soft, clear speech; no swelling music.
Performance English: Leave two seconds before Raghu responds.

Title English: The work can wait a moment
Camera English: Medium-wide two-shot at the low bench on the inland side of the landing.
Action English: Raghu takes the parcel and places it beside the bench. He sits and makes room for her. Malati sits alongside him.
Sound English: The parcel settles; the bench gives a small creak.
Performance English: He gives her his presence without a lecture.

Camera English: A quiet two-shot at bench height.
Action English: They sit quietly, looking towards the river. Malati turns to her father. He looks at her and nods. The parcel remains beside the bench.
Sound English: Only water for the first four seconds; leave another small pause at the end.
Performance English: A small smile returns. The sadness of parting has not vanished.

Camera English: One shot follows Malati rising, picking up the parcel and handing it over.
Action English: Malati gets up herself, picks up the parcel and gives it to Raghu. Both are still ashore. He looks at the knot with a small smile. She releases her hands.
Sound English: Footsteps and cloth; hold on the release after the lines.
Performance English: The handover is her choice. Raghu does not pull it from her.

Camera English: Wide rear view: Malati and Hema in the foreground, the boita moving away.
Action English: A little later. Raghu and Hari are aboard as the boita slowly leaves the landing. Malati stands beside Hema and waves. Then she takes her mother’s hand. They keep watching the river.
Sound English: An oar moving through water. No final speech or spoken moral.
Performance English: Hold for four seconds after their hands meet, then gently end.
